decision: Visible candidates require territorial compatibility and main/secondary season for the selected date; out-of-season/unknown phases hidden. Visible rows show the seasonal phase.

implementation.daily_season_phases: separate shared Predictor classification, at most 32 species x 7 days
implementation.outside_season: no model invocation or visible candidate
implementation.month_boundary: only in-season days materialized; null outside season
implementation.source: local profile phenology, no month edits
implementation.preview: same URL and arguments; synthetic authentication
